# Hydra SDK Documentation for AI Agents

This directory contains documentation optimized for LLMs and MCP agents to understand and interact with the Hydra SDK.

## Core Resources
- [Project Context](project-context.md): High-level architecture, coding standards, and project goals.
- [API Specifications](api-specs/): Detailed, machine-readable API mappings for each SDK package.

## Package API Specs
- [Core Package](api-specs/core.md): Wallet management, UTxO types, and utilities.
- [Hydra Bridge](api-specs/bridge.md): Hydra Head lifecycle and node communication.
- [Hydra Transaction](api-specs/transaction.md): Low-level TxBuilder API.
- [Cardano WASM](api-specs/cardano-wasm.md): Environment-aware WASM wrapper.

## Guidelines for Agents
1. Always check `project-context.md` before proposing architectural changes.
2. Refer to `api-specs/` for precise function signatures and return types.
3. Follow the patterns established in the codebase as described in the context.
